products.name: Agil
products.tagline: With Propaquizafop 10% Agil selectively controls grassy weeds in a wide range of broad-leaf crops like Soybean, Onion, Black gram, Chickpea, and more!
products.crops: Black gram, Chickpea, Cluster bean, Groundnut, Jute, Onion, Potato, Sesamum, Soybean, Tomato, Chilli, Sugarbeet, Oilseed rape, Sunflower, other field crops, vegetables, fruit trees...
products.modeOfAction: Propaquizafop is a post-emergence herbicide that targets and controls grass weeds. It inhibits the enzyme acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACCase) in grasses, which is essential for fatty acid synthesis. This inhibition disrupts the production of lipids, crucial components of cell membranes and other cellular structures, leading to the cessation of cell growth and division. The targeted weeds eventually die due to the inability to produce new cells.

products.pests: Cyperus iria, Cyperus difformis, Fimbristylis miliacea, Monochoria vaginalis, Ludwigia parviflora (broadleaf weeds, grasses, sedges)

products.name: Warden
products.modeOfAction: Systemic Fungicide & Systemic Insecticide
products.pests: Termite, White grub

products.name: warden Extra
products.pests: Damping off (Rhizoctonia solani) and Leafhopper (Amrasca biguttula biguttulai), Aphid (Aphis gossypii), Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)

products.name: Weed Smash
products.modeOfAction: Provides selective weed control in cotton, ensuring improved crop management.
products.pests: Trianthema sp. (Santhi), Chenopodium sp. (Bathua), Digera sp. (Tendala), Amaranthus sp., Celosia argentea

products.name: Zamir
products.pests: Die-back, Fruit-rot
